label: first input f at early original steps (t=3-4)
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, almost always when the input is the letter f (93% of activation mass), mostly at t=3 (76% of mass) and t=4 (18%), with small amounts at t=2 and t=5 and never at t=0-1 or t>=6. It is essentially always the first occurrence of the input token. Never fires on the delimiter or in the copy phase. Rare minor tokens: digit 1, p, h, d at the same positions. Magnitude is highest when the preceding prefix contains i or d (prev_tok i: 12x lift, d: 7x; top examples are like 2 i d f, t i d f, x i i f); f after other prefixes usually stays under threshold. The predicate captures 87% of activation mass but has very low precision (~6%): the unit crosses threshold on only a small fraction of early f inputs, and prefix conditions (seen i/d) raise precision to only ~15% while losing recall, so the gating context is not fully captured.
